name: forge-usd-priced-membership-nft
summary: Composed membership NFT: ERC-721 with max supply, ERC-2981 royalties, pause switch, MINTER/PAUSER roles and a paid mint priced in USD through a Chainlink ETH/USD feed with staleness checks and refunds (UsdPricedMembership). Good base for token-gated apps.

entrypoints.name: component-map.json, plan.json
entrypoints.usage: provenance: capability → component → pinned fork commit

inputs.name: constructor args
inputs.description: UsdPricedMembership(admin, maxSupply, baseURI, feed, mintPriceUsd (1e18 = $1), maxPriceAge, royaltyReceiver, royaltyBps)

compatible_with.how: the composer that generated this repo
token-gated dApp data layer (Build with Blocks recipe 1)
chainlink-price-feed starter explains the oracle pattern

env.purpose: repo secret for the Deploy workflow only; never in files
